item.title: 1.0.1-beta.3
item.description:
What's Changed

  • Onboarding Module Selection: New users can now choose which notch modules to install and enable during onboarding (Clipboard, Shelf, Calendar, Camera) instead of starting with hidden tabs (#40, #45).

  • Settings → About Improvements:

    • Added a "Run Onboarding Again" button to re-trigger the onboarding flow at any time (#45).
    • Cleaned up the About screen by removing the duplicate "Thanks" section (retained in README) (#45).

  • Issue Templates: Version dropdown now sorts releases chronologically (newest first), grouping stable releases before betas and excluding upstream fork tags (#47).

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.0.1-beta.2...v1.0.1-beta.3

item.title: 1.0.1-beta.2
item.description:
v1.0.0-beta.2

Improvements

  • Onboarding Access: Added an "Onboarding" entry to the menu bar extra to re-run onboarding anytime.
  • Onboarding Visuals: Replaced raw visual-effect background with the standard liquid-glass notch material (LiquidGlassSurface + LiquidGlassEdge), respecting transparency settings.
  • Sparkle Appcast: Updated release metadata for 1.0.0-beta.1 Sparkle feed.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.0.0-beta.1...v1.0.0-beta.2

item.title: 1.0.1-beta.1
item.description:
## v1.0.1-beta.1
### Improvements - Polished notch opening, closing, tab switching, HUD, battery, and layout motion. - Improved Shelf drops, Calendar authorization refresh, and built-in display brightness handling. - Refreshed demo media and documentation.
### Fixes - Stable Sparkle appcast publishing. - Issue-report version dropdown. - Release signing and CodeQL build reliability.
**Full Changelog**: `v1.0.0...v1.0.1-beta.1`
